Ko ʻAtama, mo Seti, mo ʻInosi,
Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
Ko Kēnani, mo Malelili, mo Seleti,
Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
Ko ʻInoke, mo Metusela, mo Lemeki,
Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
Ko Noa, mo Semi, mo Hami, mo Sefeti.
Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Sefeti; ko Komela, mo Mekoki, mo Metai, mo Savani, mo Tupale, mo Meseke, mo Tailasa.
The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Komela ko ʻAsekinasa, mo Lifata, mo Tokama.
And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Savani; ko ʻElaisa, mo Taʻasisi, mo Kitimi, mo Totenimi.
And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Hami ko Kusa, mo Misilemi, mo Futi, mo Kēnani.
The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Kusa; ko Sipa, mo Havila, mo Sapita, mo Leama, mo Sapetika. Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Leama; ko Sipa, mo Titani.
And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Kusa ʻa Nimilote pea naʻe kamata ongoongo lahi ia ʻi māmani.
And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
Pea naʻe tupu meia Misilemi ʻa Lutimi, mo ʻAnamemi, mo Lehapimi, mo Nafituhemi,
And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
Mo Patilusime, mo Kasiluhemi, (ʻaia naʻe tupu ai ʻae kakai Filisitia,) mo Kafitolime.
And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Kēnani ʻa Saitoni, ko hono ʻuluaki, pea mo Heti,
And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
Mo e kakai Sepusi foki, mo e kakai ʻAmoli, pea mo e kakai Keakasa,
The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
Mo e kakai Hevi, mo e kakai ʻAlaka, mo e kakai ʻo Sina,
And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
Mo e kakai ʻAvati, mo e kakai Semali, mo e kakai Hemati.
And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Semi; ko ʻIlami, mo ʻAsuli, mo ʻAfakisate, mo Luti, mo ʻElami, mo Usa, mo Uli, mo Ketali, mo Meseki.
The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia ʻAfakisate ʻa Sela, pea naʻe tupu ʻia Sela ʻa Ipela.
And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
Pea naʻe fanauʻi ʻae foha ʻe toko ua kia Ipela: ko e hingoa ʻoe tokotaha ko Peleki; koeʻuhi naʻe vahevahe ʻa māmani ʻi hono ngaahi ʻaho ʻoʻona: pea ko e hingoa ʻo hono tokoua ko Sokitani.
And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Sokitani ʻa ʻAlimotate, mo Silefi, mo Hesamavete, mo Sela,
And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
Ko Hatolame foki, mo Usali, mo Tikila,
Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
Mo Ipale, mo ʻApimaeli, mo Sipa,
And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
Mo Ofeli, mo Havila, mo Sopapi. Ko e ngaahi foha ʻakinautolu ni kotoa pē ʻo Sokitani.
And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
Ko Semi, mo ʻAfakisate, mo Sela,
Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
Ko Ipale, mo Peleki, mo Liu,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Ko Seluke, mo Nehoa, mo Tela,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
Ko ʻEpalame; ko ia foki ko ʻEpalahame.
Abram; the same is Abraham.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻEpalahame; ko ʻAisake, mo ʻIsimeʻeli.
The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
Ko honau ngaahi toʻutangata eni ko e ʻuluaki fānau kia ʻIsimeʻeli, ko Nepeoti; pea hoko mo ia ʻa Keta, mo ʻAtieli, mo Mipisami,
These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
Ko Misima, mo Tumaa, mo Masa, mo Hetaʻa, mo Tima,
Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
Ko Situa, mo Nefisi, mo Kitema. Ko e ngaahi foha ʻakinautolu ʻo ʻIsimeʻeli.
Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

Pea ko eni ʻae ngaahi tama ʻo Ketula ko e fefine sinifu ʻo ʻEpalahame: naʻe fanauʻi ʻe ia ʻa Similai, mo Sokesani, mo Metani, mo Mitiane, mo Isipaka, mo Suaa. Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sokesani ko Sipa, mo Titani.
Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Mitiane; ko ʻEfaa, mo ʻEfee, mo Henoke, mo ʻApaita, mo Elitaa. Ko kinautolu kotoa pē ko eni ko e ngaahi tama ʻa Ketula.
And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia ʻEpalahame ʻa ʻAisake. Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻAisake ko ʻIsoa mo ʻIsileli.
And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻIsoa; ko ʻIlifasi, mo Leueli, mo Seusi, mo Salami, mo Ko ia.
The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻIlifasi: ko Temani, mo Omaʻa, mo Sefa, mo Katami, mo Kinasi, mo Timina, mo ʻAmaleki.
The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Leueli; ko Nehate, mo Sela, mo Sama, mo Misa.
The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Seia; ko Lotani, mo Sopale, mo Sipione, mo Ena, mo Tisoni, mo Eseli, mo Tisani.
And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Lotani ko Holi, mo Homani, pea ko Timina ko e tuofefine ia ʻo Lotani.
And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sopale ko ʻAlivani, mo Maneate, mo Ipale, mo Sifo, mo Onama. Pea ko e ongo foha ʻo Sipione; ko Esaa, mo Ena.
The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Ena; ko Tisoni. Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Tisoni; ko ʻAmilami, mo Esipani, mo Itilani, mo Kilani.
The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Eseli; ko Pilani, mo Sefani, mo Ekani. Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Tisani; ko Usa, mo ʻElani.
The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
Pea ko eni ia ʻae ngaahi tuʻi naʻe pule ʻi he fonua ʻo ʻItomi ʻi he teʻeki ai ha tuʻi ke pule ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli; ko Pela ko e foha ʻo Peoli: pea ko e hingoa ʻo hono kolo ʻoʻona ko Tinapa.
Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
Pea ʻi heʻene pekia ʻa Pela, naʻe hoko mo ia ʻi he pule ʻa Sopapi ko e foha ʻo Sela ʻo Posila.
And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
Pea ʻi heʻene pekia ʻa Sopapi, naʻe hoko mo ia ki he pule ʻa Husami mei he fonua ʻoe kakai Temani.
And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
Pea ʻi heʻene pekia ʻa Husami, naʻe hoko mo ia ʻi he pule ʻa Hatati ko e foha ʻo Pitati, ʻaia naʻa ne teʻia ʻae kakai Mitiane ʻi he ngoue ʻo Moape: pea ko e hingoa ʻo hono kolo ʻoʻona ko ʻAviti.
And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
Pea ʻi heʻene pekia ʻa Hatati, naʻe hoko mo ia ki he pule ʻa Samila mei Masileka.
And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
Pea ʻi heʻene pekia ʻa Samila, naʻe hoko mo ia ki he pule ʻa Saula mei Leapote ʻi he veʻe vaitafe.
And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
Pea ʻi heʻene pekia ʻa Saula, naʻe hoko mo ia ki he pule ʻa Peali-Hanani ko e foha ʻo ʻAkepoa.
And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

Pea ʻi heʻene pekia ʻa Peali-Hanani, naʻe hoko mo ia ki he pule ʻa Hatati: pea ko e hingoa ʻo hono kolo ʻoʻona ko Pau; pea ko e hingoa ʻo hono uaifi ko Mehetepeli, ko e taʻahine ʻa Matileti, ko e taʻahine ʻa Mesaʻapi.
And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
Naʻe pekia foki ʻa Hatati. Pea ko e ngaahi ʻeiki eni ʻo ʻItomi; ko e ʻeiki ko Timina, ko e ʻeiki ko Elia, mo e ʻeiki ko Seteli,
Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
Ko e ʻeiki ko ʻAholipama, mo e ʻeiki ko Ela, mo e ʻeiki ko Pinoni,
Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
Ko e ʻeiki ko Kinasi, mo e ʻeiki ko Temani, mo e ʻeiki ko Mipisali,
Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
Ko e ʻeiki ko Makiteli, mo e ʻeiki ko ʻIlami. Ko e ngaahi ʻeiki eni ʻo ʻItomi.
Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo ʻIsileli; ko Lupeni, mo Simione, mo Livai, mo Siuta, mo ʻIsaka, mo Sepuloni,
These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
Mo Tani, mo Sosefa, mo Penisimani, mo Nafitali, mo Kata, pea mo ʻAseli.
Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Siuta; ko ʻEa, mo ʻOnani, mo Sila: naʻe fanauʻi ʻae toko tolu ko ia kiate ia ʻe he taʻahine ʻo Sua ko e fefine Kēnani. Pea naʻe kovi ʻa ʻEa, ko e ʻuluaki fānau ʻa Siuta, ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova; pea naʻa ne tāmateʻi ia.

The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
Pea naʻe fanauʻi kiate ia ʻe Tema ko hono ʻofefine ʻi he fono ʻa Felesi pea mo Selaa. Ko e ngaahi foha kotoa pē ʻo Siuta ko e toko nima.
And Tamar his daughter in law bore him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Felesi ko Hesiloni mo Hamuli.
The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Selaa ko Simili, mo Etani, mo Hemani, mo Kalikoli, pea mo Tala: ko e lau toko nima ʻakinautolu.
And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Kalimi; ko ʻAkali, ʻaia ko e fakamaveuveu ʻo ʻIsileli, ʻaia naʻe fai angahala ʻi he meʻa naʻe fakatapui.
And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Etani; ko ʻAsalia.
And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha foki ʻo Hesiloni, ʻaia naʻe fānau kiate ia; ko Silamili, mo Lami, pea mo Kilupai.
The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
Pea naʻe fanauʻi kia Lami ʻa ʻAminitapi; pea fanauʻi kia ʻAminitapi ʻa Nasoni, ko e ʻeiki ʻoe fānau ʻa Siuta.
And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
Pea naʻe fanauʻi kia Nasoni ʻa Salima, pea fanauʻi kia Salima ʻa Poasi,
And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
Pea naʻe fanauʻi kia Poasi, ʻa ʻOpeti, pea fanauʻi kia ʻOpeti ʻa Sese.
And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
Pea naʻe fanauʻi kia Sese ʻa hono ʻuluaki foha ko ʻIliapi, pea ko ʻApinatapi ko hono toko ua, pea mo Sima ko hono toko tolu,
And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
Mo Netanili ko hono toko fā, mo Latei ko hono toko nima,
Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
Mo Osemi ko hono toko ono, mo Tevita ko hono toko fitu:
Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
Pea ko hono ngaahi tuofefine ʻoʻona ko Seluia, mo ʻApikali. Pea ko e ngaahi tama ʻa Seluia; ko ʻApisai, mo Soape, pea mo ʻAsaeli, ko e toko tolu.
Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
Pea naʻe fanauʻi ʻe ʻApikali ʻa ʻAmasa: pea ko e tamai ʻa ʻAmasa ko Seteli ko e tangata ʻIsimeʻeli.
And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
Pea naʻe fanauʻi kia Kelepi ko e foha ʻo Hesiloni ʻae ngaahi fānau ʻia ʻAsupa ko hono uaifi, pea ʻia Silioti: ko eni ʻa ʻene ngaahi tama ʻaʻana; ko Sesa, mo Sopapi, mo ʻAlitoni.
And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
Pea ʻi heʻene hoko ʻo pekia ʻa ʻAsupa, naʻe ʻomi ʻe Kelepi kiate ia ʻa Efalata, ʻaia naʻe fanauʻi kiate ia ʻa Hua.
And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
Pea naʻe fanauʻi kia Hua ʻa Uli, pea fanauʻi kia Uli ʻa Pesalili.
And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.

Pea hili ia naʻe hū ange ʻa Hesiloni ki he ʻofefine ʻo Mekili ko e tamai ʻa Kiliati, ʻaia naʻa ne mali husepāniti ki ai ʻi hono onongofulu taʻu ʻo ʻene motuʻa; pea naʻa ne fanauʻi ʻe ia kiate ia ʻa Sikupi.
And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
Pea naʻe fanauʻi kia Sikupi ʻa Saili, ʻaia naʻe ʻoʻona ʻae kolo ʻe uofulu ma tolu ʻi he fonua ʻo Kiliati.
And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

Pea naʻa ne kapasia ʻa Kesuli, mo ʻAlami, fakataha mo e ngaahi kolo ʻo Saili, meiate kinautolu, mo Kinati, mo hono ngaahi kolo ʻo ia, ʻio, ʻae kolo ʻe onongofulu. naʻe ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Mekili ko e tamai ʻa Kiliati, ʻae ngaahi potu ni kotoa pē.
And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
Pea ʻi he hili ʻae pekia ʻa Hesiloni ʻi Kelepi-Efalata, naʻe toki fanauʻi kiate ia ʻe ʻApia ko e uaifi ʻo Hesiloni, ʻa ʻAsuli ko e tamai ʻa Tikoa.
And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Silamili ko e ʻuluaki foha ʻo Hesiloni; ko Lami ko e ʻuluaki fānau, mo Puna, mo Oleni, mo Osemi, mo ʻAhisa.
And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
Pea naʻe ai mo e uaifi ʻe tokotaha ʻo Silamili, ʻaia naʻe hingoa ko ʻAtala; ko e faʻē ia ʻa Onami.
Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Lami ko e ʻuluaki fānau ʻa Silamili; ko Maʻasi, mo Samini, mo Ekeli.
And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Onami ko Samei, mo Sata. Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Samei; ko Natapi, mo ʻApisuli.
And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
Pea ko e hingoa ʻoe uaifi ʻo ʻApisuli, ko ʻEpieli, pea naʻa ne fānau ʻe ia kiate ia ʻa ʻApani mo Moliti.
And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Natapi ko Seleti, mo ʻApaiʻimi: ka naʻe mate ʻa Seleti taʻehafānau.
And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo ʻApaiʻimi ko Isi. Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Isi ko Sesani. Pea ko e fānau ʻa Sesani ko ʻAlai.
And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sata ko e tokoua ʻo Samei; ko Seteli, mo Sonatane: pea naʻe mate ʻa Seteli taʻehafānau.
And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sonatane; ko Peleti, mo Sasa. Ko e ngaahi foha ʻakinautolu ni ʻo Silamili.
And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
Ka ko eni naʻe ʻikai maʻu ʻe Sesani ha ngaahi foha ka ko e ngaahi ʻofefine. Pea naʻe maʻu ʻe Sesani ha tamaioʻeiki, ko e tangata ʻIsipite, ʻaia naʻe hingoa ko Salia.
Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
Pea naʻe foaki ʻe Sesani ʻa hono ʻofefine kia Salia ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki ke na fakamaʻu; pea naʻa ne fanauʻi ʻe ia ʻa ʻAtai.
And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia ʻAtai ʻa Natani, pea tupu ʻia Natani ʻa Sapati,
And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Sapati, ʻa ʻEfilali, pea tupu ʻia ʻEfilali ʻa ʻOpeti,
And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia ʻOpeti ʻa Sehu, pea tupu ʻia Sehu ʻa ʻAsalia,
And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia ʻAsalia ʻa Helesi, pea tupu ʻia Helesi ʻa Elasa,
And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Elasa ʻa Sisemei, pea tupu ʻia Sisemei ʻa Salumi,
And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Salumi ʻa Sikamia, pea tupu ʻia Sikamia ʻa ʻIlisama.
And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
Ka ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Kelepi ko e tokoua ʻo Silamili: ko Mesa ko hono ʻuluaki fānau, ʻaia ko e tamai ʻa Sifi; pea mo e ngaahi foha ʻo Malesa ko e tamai ʻa Hepeloni.
Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Hepeloni: ko Kola, mo Tapua, mo Likemi, pea mo Sema.
And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Sema ʻa Leami ko e tamai ʻa Sokoami; pea naʻe tupu ʻia Likemi ʻa Samei.
And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
Pea ko e foha ʻo Samei ko Maoni: pea ko Maoni ko e tamai ia kia Pete-Sua.
And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
Pea ko Efa, ko e fefine sinifu kia Kelepi, naʻe fanauʻi ʻe ia ʻa Helani, mo Mosa, mo Kesesi: pea naʻe tupu ʻia Helani ʻa Kesesi.
And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Satei; ko Likemi, mo Sotani, mo Kesemi, mo Pelati, mo Efa, pea mo Seafi.
And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
Ko Meaka, ko e fefine sinifu ʻa Kelepi, naʻe fanauʻi ʻe ia ʻa Sepeli mo Tilena.
Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
Naʻa ne fanauʻi foki ʻe ia ʻa Seafi ko e tamai ʻa Matimana, ko Siva ko e tamai ʻa Makipena, pea mo e tamai ʻa Kepa: pea ko e ʻofefine ʻo Kelepi naʻe ui ko ʻAkesa.
She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Kelepi ko e foha ʻo Hua, ko e ʻuluaki fānau kia Efalata; ko Sopale ko e tamai ʻa Kesasialimi,
These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim,
Ko Salima ko e tamai ʻa Petelihema, mo Halefi ko e tamai ʻa Petekateli.
Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.
Pea ko Sopale ko e tamai ʻa Kesasialimi naʻe maʻu ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi foha; ko Haloe, mo hono vaheua mālie ʻoe kakai Maneata.
And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
Pea ko e ngaahi faʻahinga eni ʻo Kesasialimi; ko e kakai Itila, mo e kakai Pua, mo e kakai Sumati, mo e kakai Misila; pea naʻe tupu meiate kinautolu ʻae kakai Salea, mo e kakai Esitaoli.
And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Salima; ko Petelihema mo e kakai Nitofa, mo e kakai ʻAtaloti, ko e fale ʻo Soape, pea mo hono vaeua mālie ʻoe kakai Maneata, ko e kakai Sola.
The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

Pea ko e ngaahi faʻahinga eni ʻoe kau tangata tohi naʻe nofo ʻi Sepesi; ko e kakai Tilati, mo e kakai Simia, mo e kakai Sukati. Ko kinautolu eni ʻae kakai Kēnani naʻe tupu meia Hemati, ko e tamai ʻae fale ʻo Lekapi.
And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

Pea ko eni ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Tevita, ʻakinautolu naʻe fānau kiate ia ʻi Hepeloni; ko e ʻuluaki fānau ko ʻAmanoni, ʻia ʻAhinoami ko e fefine Sesilili; ko hono toko ua ko Taniela, ʻia ʻApikali ko e fefine Kameli:
Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
Ko hono toko tolu, ko ʻApisalomi ko e tama ʻa Meaka ko e ʻofefine ʻo Talimei ko e tuʻi ʻo Kesuli: ko hono toko fā, ko ʻAtonisa ko e tama ʻa Hakiti:
The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
Ko hono toko nima, ko Sifatia ʻia ʻApitali: ko hono toko ono, ko Itiliami ʻia Ekila ko hono uaifi.
The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
Naʻe fanauʻi ʻae toko ono ni kiate ia ʻi Hepeloni; pea naʻa ne pule ʻi ai ʻi he taʻu ʻe fitu mo e māhina ʻe ono: pea naʻa ne pule ʻi Selūsalema, ʻi he taʻu ʻe tolungofulu ma tolu.
These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
Pea ko kinautolu eni naʻe fanauʻi kiate ia ʻi Selūsalema; ko Samua, mo Sopapi, mo Natani, pea mo Solomone, ko e toko fā ʻia Patisua ko e ʻofefine ʻo ʻAmieli:
And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:
Ko Ipia foki, mo ʻIlisua, mo Ilifileti.
Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
Mo Noka, mo Nefeki, mo Safia,
And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
Mo ʻIlisama, mo Iliata, pea mo Ilifileti, ko e toko hiva.
And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
Ko e ngaahi foha eni kotoa pē ʻo Tevita, ka ʻoku lau kehe ʻae ngaahi tama ʻae kau sinifu, pea mo Tamaa ko honau tuofefine.
These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
Pea ko e foha ʻo Solomone, ko Lehopoami, ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko ʻApia, ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko ʻAsa, ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko Sihosafate,
And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko Solami, ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko ʻAhasia, ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko Soasi,
Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
Ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko ʻAmasia, ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko ʻAsalia, ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko Sotami,
Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
Ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko ʻAhasi, ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko Hesekaia, ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko Manase,
Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
Ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko ʻAmoni, pea ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko Sosaia.
Amon his son, Josiah his son.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Sosaia, ko hono ʻuluaki fānau ko Sohanani, ko hono toko ua ko Sihoiakimi, ko hono toko tolu ʻa Setikia, ko hono toko fā ʻa Salumi.
And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Sihoiakimi: ko Sekonia ko hono foha, pea ko hono foha ʻoʻona ko Setikia.
And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Sekonia; ko Esili, mo Salatieli ko hono foha,
And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
Ko Malikilami foki, mo Pitaia, mo Senasa, mo Sekamia, mo Hosama, mo Nitapia.
Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Pitaia, ko Selupepeli, mo Simi: pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Selupepeli; ko Mesulami, mo Hanania, pea mo Silomiti ko honau tuofefine:
And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
Mo Hasupa, mo Oeli, mo Pelekia, mo Hasatia, mo Susapi-Heseti, ko e toko nima.
And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Hanania ko Pelatia, mo Sisaia; ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Lifaia, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Elinani, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻOpataia, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sikania.
And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sikania; ko Simaia: pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Simaia; ko Hatusi, mo Ikiali, mo Pelaia, mo Nealia, mo Safati, ko e toko ono.
And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Nealia; ko Ilionei, mo Hesekaia, mo ʻAsilikami, ko e toko tolu.
And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Ilionei, ko Hotaia, mo Iliasipi, mo Pelaia, mo ʻAkupi, mo Sohanani, mo Tilaia, mo ʻAnani, ko e toko fitu.
And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Siuta; ko Felesi, mo Hasiloni, mo Kalimi, mo Uli, mo Sopale.
The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Liaia ko e foha ʻo Sopale ʻa Seati; pea naʻe tupu ʻia Seati ʻa ʻEhumai, mo Lehati. Ko kinautolu eni ʻae faʻahinga ʻoe kakai Sola.
And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
Pea naʻe tupu mai eni mei he tamai ʻa Etama: ko Sesilili, mo Isima, mo Itipasi: pea ko e hingoa ʻo honau tuofefine ko Haseliponi:
And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
Pea ko Penieli ko e tamai ʻa Kitoa, mo ʻAseli ko e tamai ʻa Husa. Ko kinautolu ni ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Hua, ko e ʻuluaki fānau kia Efalata, ko e tamai ʻa Petelihema.
And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
Pea ko ʻAsuli ko e tamai ʻa Tikoa naʻe maʻu ʻae uaifi ʻe toko ua, ko Hela mo Neala.
And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
Pea naʻe fanauʻi ʻe Neala kiate ia ʻa ʻAhusami, mo Hefeli, mo Temini, mo ʻEhasitali. Ko e ngaahi tama eni ʻa Neala.
And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
Pea ko e ngaahi tama eni ʻa Hela, ko Seleti, mo Sisoa, mo Etinani.
And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Kosi ʻa ʻAnupi, mo Sopepa, mo e ngaahi faʻahinga ʻo ʻEhaleli ko e foha ʻo Halumi.
And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
Pea naʻe ongoongolelei lahi hake ʻa Sepesi ʻi hono kāinga: pea naʻe ui ʻa hono hingoa ʻe heʻene faʻē ko Sepesi, ko ʻene pehē, Koeʻuhi naʻaku fāʻeleʻi ia ʻi he mamahi.
And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

Pea naʻe lotu ʻa Sepesi ki he ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli, ʻo pehē, “Taumaiā, te ke tāpuaki moʻoni au, mo fakalahi ʻa hoku mata fonua, pea ke kau mai ho nima kiate au, pea ke maluʻi au mei he kovi, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻaku mamahi ai!” Pea naʻe foaki ʻe he ʻOtua ʻae meʻa naʻa ne kole ki ai.

And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Kilupi ko e tokoua ʻo Sua ʻa Mili, ʻaia ko e tamai kia Esitoni.
And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Esitoni ʻa Pete-Lafa, mo Pasea, mo Tihina ko e tamai ʻa Ilinahasi. Ko e kau tangata ia ʻo Leka.
And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Kinasi; ko e Otenili, mo Selaia: pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Otinili, ko Hetati.
And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Meonotei ʻa Ofila: pea naʻe tupu ʻia Selaia ʻa Soape, ko e tamai ʻoe kakai ʻoe potu talalo ʻo Kalasimi; he ko e kau tufunga ʻakinautolu.
And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Kelepi ko e foha ʻo Sifune; ko Ilu, mo Ela, mo Naʻami: pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Ela, ʻio, ʻa Kinasi.
And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sihalelili; ko Sifi, mo Sifa, mo Tilia, mo Esalili.
And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Esela, ko Seteli, mo Meleti, mo ʻEfeli, mo Saloni: pea naʻe fanauʻi ʻe ia ʻa Miliame, mo Samei, pea mo Isipa ko e tamai ʻa Esitimoa.
And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

Pea naʻe fanauʻi ʻe hono uaifi mei he kakai Siuta ʻa Seleti ko e tamai ʻa Kitoa, mo Hepa ko e tamai ʻa Soko, mo Sikutili ko e tamai ʻa Sanoa. Pea ko e ngaahi tama eni ʻo Pitia ko e ʻofefine ʻa Felo, ʻaia naʻe mali mo Meleti.
And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
Pea ko e ngaahi tama ʻae fefine ko Hotia ko e tuofefine ʻo Neami, ko e tamai ʻa Kila ko e tangata Kamai, mo Esitimoa ko e tangata Meaka.
And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Simoni, ko ʻAmanoni, mo Lina, mo Penihanani, mo Tiloni. Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Isi eni, ko Soheti mo Penisoheti.
And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Benzoheth.

Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sela ko e foha ʻo Siuta, ko ʻEa ko e tamai ʻa Leka, mo Lata ko e tamai ʻa Malesa, pea mo e ngaahi faʻahinga ʻoe fale ʻokinautolu naʻe ngaohi ʻae tupenu lelei lahi, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Esipea.
The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
Mo Sokimi, mo e kau tangata ʻo Kosepa, mo Soasi, mo Salafi, ʻaia naʻe ʻaʻana ʻae pule ʻi Moape, mo Sasupi lehemi. Pea ko e ngaahi meʻa muʻa eni.
And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And these are ancient things.
Ko e kau tufunga ipu ʻumea ʻakinautolu ni, pea mo kinautolu naʻe nofo ki he tō ngoue mo e ngaahi ʻakau; naʻa nau nofo ai mo e tuʻi ke fai ʻene ngāue.
These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Simione, ko Nimueli, Mo Samini, mo Salipi, mo Sela, mo Sauli:
The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
Ko Salumi ko hono foha, mo Mipisami ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Misima ko hono foha ʻoʻona.
Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Misima; ko Hamueli ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Sakuli ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Simi ko hono foha ʻoʻona.
And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.

Pea naʻe maʻu ʻe Simi ʻae ngaahi foha ʻe toko hongofulu ma toko ono, mo e ngaahi ʻofefine ʻe toko ono; ka naʻe ʻikai ke tokolahi ʻae fānau ʻo hono ngaahi tokoua, pea naʻe ʻikai ke fanafanau lahi ʻa hono faʻahinga kotoa pē, ke hangē ko e fānau ʻa Siuta.
And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
Pea naʻa nau nofo ʻi Peasipa, mo Molata, mo e ngaahi kolo ʻo Suali.
And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
Pea ʻi Pilaʻa, pea ʻi Esemi, pea ʻi Tolati,
And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
Pea ʻi Petueli, pea ʻi Hoama, pea ʻi Sikilaki,
And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
Pea ʻi Pete-Malikapoti, mo e ngaahi kolo ʻo Susimi, pea ʻi Petepilei, pea ʻi Saelimi. Ko honau ngaahi kolo eni ʻo aʻu ki he pule ʻa Tevita.
And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
Pea ko honau ngaahi kolo siʻi, ko Etama, mo ʻAini, mo Limoni, mo Tokeni, mo ʻAsani, ko e kolo ʻe nima:
And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
Pea mo honau ngaahi kolo siʻi naʻe tuʻu takatakai ʻi he ngaahi kolo ko ia, ʻo aʻu ki Peali. Ko eni ia ʻahonau ngaahi nofoʻanga ʻo fakatatau mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga.
And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
Pea ko Mesopapi, mo Samileki, mo Sosa ko e foha ʻo ʻAmasia.
And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,
Mo Soeli, mo Sehu ko e foha ʻo Sosipia, ko e foha ʻo Selaia, ko e foha ʻo Esieli,
And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
Mo Ilionei, mo Sakopa, mo Sisohaia, mo ʻAsaia, mo ʻAtieli, mo Sesimieli, mo Penaia,
And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
Mo Sisa ko e foha ʻo Sifi, ko e foha ʻo ʻAloni, ko e foha ʻo Sitaia, ko e foha ʻo Simili, ko e foha ʻo Simaia;
And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
Ko kinautolu ni kuo lau honau hingoa, ko e houʻeiki ʻakinautolu ʻo honau ngaahi faʻahinga: pea naʻe tupu ʻo tokolahi ʻaupito ʻae fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai.
These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
Pea naʻa nau ʻalu atu ki he hūʻanga ki Kitoa, ki he potu hahake ʻoe teleʻa, ke kumi ʻae potu mohukuʻia maʻa ʻenau fanga manu.
And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
Pea naʻa nau ʻilo ʻae potu mohukuʻia mo lelei, pea naʻe ʻataʻatā ʻae fonua, mo nofo lelei, mo melino pe; he naʻe nofo ʻi muʻa ʻi ai ʻae kakai Hami.
And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.

Pea ko kinautolu ni naʻe tohi ʻa honau hingoa naʻe haʻu ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo Hesekaia ko e tuʻi ʻo Siuta, ʻonau teʻia honau ngaahi fale fehikitaki, pea mo e kakai Maoni naʻe ʻilo ʻi ai, mo nau fakaʻauha ʻaupito ia ʻo aʻu mai ki he ʻaho ni, pea naʻa nau nofo ʻi honau ngaahi potu: koeʻuhi naʻe ʻi ai ʻae mohuku ki heʻenau fanga manu.

And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.

Pea naʻe ʻiate kinautolu, ʻae fānau ʻa Simione, ko e kau tangata ʻe toko nimangeau, naʻe ʻalu ki he moʻunga ko Seia, pea ko honau ngaahi ʻeikitau ko Pelatia, mo Nealia, mo Lifaia, pea mo ʻUsili, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Isi.
And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
Pea naʻa nau teʻia ʻae toenga ʻoe kakai ʻAmaleki naʻe hao, mo nau nofo ai ʻo aʻu mai ki he ʻaho ni.
And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.

Ko eni ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Lupeni, ko e ʻuluaki fānau kia ʻIsileli, (he ko e ʻuluaki fānau ia; ka ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene fakaʻuliʻi ʻae mohenga ʻo ʻene tamai, ko ia naʻe foaki ai ʻae ʻinasi ʻoe ʻuluaki fānau ki he ngaahi foha ʻo Sosefa ko e foha ʻo ʻIsileli: pea ʻoku ʻikai lau ʻae hohoko ʻo fai mei he ʻuluaki fānau.

Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
He naʻe mālohi hake ʻa Siuta ki hono ngaahi tokoua, pea naʻe meiate ia ʻae ʻeiki pule, ka ko e ʻinasi ʻoe ʻuluaki fānau naʻe ʻia Sosefa ia:)
For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph’s:)
‌ʻIo, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Lupeni ko e ʻuluaki fānau kia ʻIsileli, ko Henoke, mo Falu, mo Hesiloni, mo Kalimi.
The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Soeli; ko Simaia ko hono foha, mo Koki ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Simi ko hono foha ʻoʻona,
The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
Ko Maika ko hono foha ʻoʻona, ko Liaia ko hono foha ʻoʻona, ko Peali ko hono foha ʻoʻona,
Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
Ko Piela ko hono foha ʻoʻona, ʻaia naʻe ʻave fakapōpula ʻe Tekilati-Pilesa ko e tuʻi ʻo ʻAsilia: ko e ʻeiki ia ʻoe faʻahinga ʻo Lupeni.
Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
Pea ko e tuʻukimuʻa eni ʻi hono ngaahi tokoua ʻoʻona ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi heʻene lau hake ʻae hohoko ʻo honau ngaahi toʻutangata, ko Sehieli, mo Sakalia,
And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
Mo Pela ko e foha ʻo ʻAsasi, ko e foha ʻo Sema, ko e foha ʻo Soeli, ʻaia naʻe nofo ʻi ʻAloeli, ʻo aʻu atu ki Nipo mo Peali mioni.
And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:
Pea ki he feituʻu hahake naʻa ne nofo ʻo aʻu atu ki he hūʻanga ʻoe toafa mei he vaitafe ko ʻIufaletesi: koeʻuhi naʻe tupu ʻo lahi ʻenau fanga manu ʻi he fonua ʻo Kiliati.
And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
Pea ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo Saula naʻa nau fai ʻae tau ki he kakai Hekaʻā, pea naʻa nau tō hifo ʻi honau nima: pea naʻa nau nofo ʻi honau ngaahi falefehikitaki ʻi he feituʻu hahake kotoa pē ʻo Kiliati.
And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
Pea naʻe nofo hangatonu mai kiate kinautolu ʻae fānau ʻa Kata, ʻi he fonua ʻo Pesani, mo Salika:
And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salcah:
Ko Soeli ko e ʻeiki lahi, pea hoko mo ia ʻa Safami, mo Sanei, mo Safati ʻi Pesani.
Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
Pea ko honau kāinga eni ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ko Mikaeli, mo Mesulami, mo Sepa, mo Solei, mo Sakani, mo Sia, mo Hepa, ko e toko fitu.
And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
Pea ko e fānau eni ʻa ʻApieli ko e foha ʻo Huli, ko e foha ʻo Saloa, ko e foha ʻo Kiliati, ko e foha ʻo Mikaeli, ko e foha ʻo Sesisai, ko e foha ʻo Sato, ko e foha ʻo Pusa;
These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
Ko ʻAhi ko e foha ʻo ʻApitieli, ko e foha ʻo Kuni, ko e ʻeiki ia ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai.
Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
Pea naʻa nau nofo ʻi Kiliati ʻi Pesani, pea ʻi hono ngaahi kolo, pea ʻi he ngaahi potu tuaʻā ʻo Saloni, ʻi honau ngaahi ngataʻanga fonua.
And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
naʻe lau hake eni kotoa pē ʻo fakatatau mo honau ngaahi toʻutangata ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo Sotami ko e tuʻi ʻo Siuta, pea ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo Selopoami ko e tuʻi ʻo ʻIsileli.
All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Lupeni, mo e kakai Kata, mo hono vahe ua ʻoe faʻahinga ʻa Manase, ʻae kau tangata toʻa, ko e kau tangata naʻe faʻa toʻo ʻae pā pea mo e heletā, pea faʻa fanaʻaki ʻae kaufana, mo poto ʻi he tau, ko honau tokolahi ko e toko fā mano, mo e fā afe ma fitungeau ma onongofulu, naʻe ʻalu atu ki he tau.

The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
Pea naʻa nau fakalanga ʻae tau ki he kakai Hekaʻā, pea kia Setuli, mo Nafisi, pea mo Notapi.
And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

Pea naʻe tokoni ʻakinautolu ʻi heʻenau fai kiate kinautolu, pea naʻe tukuange ʻae kakai Hekaʻā ki honau nima, pea mo kinautolu kotoa pē naʻe kau mo kinautolu: he naʻa nau tangi ki he ʻOtua ʻi he tau, pea naʻa ne fakaongo kiate kinautolu; koeʻuhi naʻa nau fakafalala kiate ia.

And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
Pea naʻa nau ʻave ʻa ʻenau fanga manu; ko e fanga kāmeli ʻe nima mano, mo e fanga sipi ʻe ua kilu mo e nima mano, mo e fanga ʻasi ʻe ua afe, pea mo e kakai tangata ʻe tokotaha kilu,
And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
He naʻe tō ʻo mate ʻae fuʻu tokolahi, he naʻe mei he ʻOtua ʻae tau. Pea naʻa nau nofo ʻi honau ngaahi potu ʻonautolu ʻo aʻu ki he kuonga ʻoe fakapōpula.
For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
Pea naʻe nofo ʻi he fonua ʻae fānau ʻoe vahe ua ʻoe faʻahinga ʻo Manase: naʻa nau tupu ʻo tokolahi mei Pesani ʻo aʻu atu ki Peali-Heamoni, mo Sinili, ʻo aʻu ki he moʻunga ko Heamoni.
And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

Pea ko kinautolu eni ʻae kau mātuʻa ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻio, ʻa Hefeli, mo Isi, mo Ilieli, mo ʻAsilieli, mo Selemaia, mo Hotevia, mo Satieli, ko e kau tangata toʻa lahi, ko e kau tangata ongoongo lahi, mo e kau mātuʻa ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai.

And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
Pea naʻa nau fai angahala ki he ʻOtua ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, pea naʻa nau ʻalu kehe ke muimui ki he ngaahi ʻotua ʻoe kakai ʻoe fonua, ʻaia naʻe fakaʻauha ʻe he ʻOtua ʻi muʻa ʻiate kinautolu.
And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

Pea naʻe ueʻi hake ʻe he ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli ʻae loto ʻo Puli ko e tuʻi ʻo ʻAsilia, mo e loto ʻo Tekilati-Pilesa ko e tuʻi ʻo ʻAsilia, pea naʻa ne ʻave pōpula ʻakinautolu, ʻio, ʻae kakai Lupeni, mo e kakai Kata, mo e vahe ua ʻoe faʻahinga ʻo Manase, pea naʻa ne ʻomi ʻakinautolu ki Hela, mo Hapoa, mo Hala, pea ki he vaitafe ko Kosani, ʻo aʻu mai ki he kuonga ni.

And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
Ko kinautolu ni ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Livai; ko Kesoni, mo Kohate, mo Melali.
The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate; ko ʻAmilami, mo ʻIsa, mo Hepeloni, mo ʻUsili.
And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
Pea ko e fānau ʻa ʻAmilami; ko ʻElone, mo Mōsese pea mo Miliame. Ko e ngaahi foha foki ʻo ʻElone; ko Natapi, mo ʻApiu, mo ʻEliesa, pea mo ʻItama.
And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Naʻe tupu ʻia ʻEliesa ʻa Finiasi, pea tupu ʻia Finiasi ʻa ʻApisua,
Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
Pea tupu ʻia ʻApisua ʻa Puki, pea tupu ʻia Puki ʻa Usi,
And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
Pea tupu ʻia Usi ʻa Silaia, pea tupu ʻia Silaia ʻa Milaioti,
And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Milaioti ʻa ʻAmalia, pea tupu ʻia ʻAmalia ʻa ʻAhitupe,
Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
Pea tupu ʻia ʻAhitupe ʻa Satoki, pea tupu ʻia Satoki ʻa ʻAhimeasi,
And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
Pea tupu ʻia ʻAhimeasi ʻa ʻAsalia, pea tupu ʻia ʻAsalia ʻa Sohanani,
And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
Pea tupu ʻia Sohanani ʻa ʻAsalia, (ko ia ia naʻe fai ʻae ngāue fakataulaʻeiki ʻi he faletapu naʻe langa ʻe Solomone ʻi Selūsalema:)
And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia ʻAsalia ʻa ʻAmalia, pea tupu ʻia ʻAmalia ʻa ʻAhitupe,
And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
Pea tupu ʻia ʻAhitupe ʻa Satoki, pea tupu ʻia Satoki ʻa Salumi,
And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
Pea tupu ʻia Salumi ʻa Hilikia, pea tupu ʻia Hilikia ʻa ʻAsalia,
And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
Pea tupu ʻia ʻAsalia ʻa Selaia, pea tupu ʻia Selaia ʻa Sihosataki,
And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
Pea naʻe fakapōpulaʻi ʻa Sihosataki, ʻi heʻene ʻave ʻe Sihova ʻa Siuta mo Selūsalema ʻi he nima ʻo Nepukanesa.
And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Livai; ko Kesomi, mo Kohate, mo Melali.
The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
Pea ko e hingoa eni ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Kesomi; ko Lipinai, mo Simi.
And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Kohate, ko ʻAmilami mo ʻIsa, mo Hepeloni, pea mo ʻUsili.
And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Melali; ko Mali, mo Musi. Pea ko e ngaahi faʻahinga eni ʻoe kau Livai ʻo fakatatau mo ʻenau ngaahi tamai.
The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
‌ʻIa Kesomi; ko Lipinai ko hono foha, mo Sehati ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Sima ko hono foha ʻoʻona,
Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Mo Soa ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Ito ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Selaa ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Siatelai ko hono foha ʻoʻona.
Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate; ko ʻAminatapi ko hono foha, mo Kola ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo ʻAsili ko hono foha ʻoʻona,
The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
Mo ʻElikena ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Epiasafi ko hono foha, mo ʻAsili ko hono foha,
Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
Mo Tehati ko hono foha, mo Ulieli ko hono foha, mo Sauli ko hono foha.
Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻElikena; ko ʻAmasai mo ʻAhimoti.
And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
Pea ko ʻElikena: ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻElikena; ko Sofei ko hono foha, mo Nehati ko hono foha,
As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
Mo ʻIliapi ko hono foha, mo Siloami ko hono foha, mo ʻElikena ko hono foha.
Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Samuela; ko e ʻuluaki fānau ko Vasini pea mo Epia.
And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Melali; ko Mali, mo Lipinai ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Simi ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Usa ko hono foha ʻoʻona,
The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
Mo Simi ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Hakia ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo ʻAsaia ko hono foha ʻoʻona.
Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
Pea ko kinautolu eni naʻe tuku ʻe Tevita ke ʻanautolu ʻae fai ʻae hiva ʻi he fale ʻo Sihova, hili ʻae hoko ʻae puha ʻoe fuakava ki hono mālōlōʻanga.
And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.

Pea naʻa nau fai ʻae hiva ʻi he ʻao ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakataha, ʻo aʻu ki he kuonga naʻe langa ai ʻe Solomone ʻae fale ʻo Sihova ʻi Selūsalema: pea naʻa nau fai fakaholo ʻenau ngāue ʻo fakatatau mo honau ngaahi lakanga.

And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
Pea ko kinautolu eni naʻe tutuʻu fakataha mo ʻenau fānau. ʻI he ngaahi foha ʻoe kakai Kohate: ko Hemani ko e tangata fasi hiva, ko e foha ʻo Soeli, ko e foha ʻo Simueli,
And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
Ko e foha ʻo ʻElikena, ko e foha ʻo Siholami, ko e foha ʻo Ilieli, ko e foha ʻo Toa,
The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
Ko e foha ʻo Sufi, ko e foha ʻo ʻElikena, ko e foha ʻo Mehati, ko e foha ʻo ʻAmasai,
The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
Ko e foha ʻo ʻElikena, ko e foha ʻo Soeli, ko e foha ʻo ʻAsalia, ko e foha ʻo Sefania,
The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
Ko e foha ʻo Tehati, ko e foha ʻo ʻAsili, ko e foha ʻo Epiasafi, ko e foha ʻo Kola,
The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
Ko e foha ʻo ʻIsa, ko e foha ʻo Kohate, ko e foha ʻo Livai, ko e foha ʻo ʻIsileli.
The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
Pea ko hono tokoua ko ʻAsafi, ʻaia naʻe tuʻu ki hono nima toʻomataʻu, ʻio, ʻa ʻAsafi ko e foha ʻo Pelekia ko e foha ʻo Simia,
And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
Ko e foha ʻo Mikaeli, ko e foha ʻo Peaseia, ko e foha ʻo Malikia,
The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
Ko e foha ʻo Etini, ko e foha ʻo Sela, ko e foha ʻo ʻAtaia,
The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
Ko e foha ʻo Etani, ko e foha ʻo Sima, ko e foha ʻo Simi,
The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
Ko e foha ʻo Sehati, ko e foha ʻo Kesomi, ko e foha ʻo Livai.
The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
Pea naʻe tutuʻu ʻa honau ngaahi tokoua ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Melali ki he nima toʻohema: ko Etani ko e foha ʻo Kisi, ko e foha ʻo ʻApiti, ko e foha ʻo Maluki,
And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
Ko e foha ʻo Hesapia, ko e foha ʻo ʻAmasia, ko e foha ʻo Hilikia,
The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
Ko e foha ʻo ʻAmisi, ko e foha ʻo Pani, ko e foha ʻo Sameli,
The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
Ko e foha ʻo Mali, ko e foha ʻo Musi, ko e foha ʻo Melali, ko e foha ʻo Livai.
The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
Naʻe fakanofo foki ʻa honau kāinga ko e kau Livai ki he ngāue kehekehe ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe fale ʻoe ʻOtua.
Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

Ka naʻe fai feilaulau ʻe ʻElone pea mo hono ngaahi foha ʻi he funga feilaulauʻanga ʻoe feilaulau tutu, pea mo e feilaulauʻanga ʻoe meʻa namu kakala, mo e ngāue kotoa pē ʻoe potu toputapu ʻaupito, pea ke fai ha fakalelei koeʻuhi ko ʻIsileli; ʻo fakatatau mo ia kotoa pē naʻe fekauʻi ʻe Mōsese ko e tamaioʻeiki ʻae ʻOtua.

But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo ʻElone ko hono foha ko ʻEliesa, mo hono foha ko Finiasi, mo hono foha ko ʻApisua,
And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
Ko hono foha ko Puki, mo hono foha ko Usi, mo hono foha ko Silaia,
Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
Mo Milaioti ko hono foha, mo ʻAmalia ko hono foha, mo ʻAhitupe ko hono foha,
Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
Ko Satoki ko hono foha, mo ʻAhimeasi ko hono foha.
Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
Pea ko eni ia ʻa honau ngaahi nofoʻanga ʻi honau ngaahi kolo mālohi ʻo honau fonua, ʻi he ngaahi foha ʻo ʻElone, mo e ngaahi faʻahinga ʻoe kakai Kohate: he naʻe ʻonautolu ʻae tohi ʻoe talotalo.
Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
Pea naʻa nau foaki ʻa Hepeloni kiate kinautolu ʻi he fonua ʻo Siuta, pea mo e ngaahi potu naʻe tuʻu takatakai ʻo ofi ki ai.
And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
Ka ko e ngaahi ngoue ʻoe kolo, mo hono ngaahi potu kakai siʻi, naʻa nau foaki ia kia Kelepi ko e foha ʻo Sifune.
But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

Pea ki he ngaahi foha ʻo ʻElone naʻa nau foaki ʻae ngaahi kolo ʻo Siuta, ʻio, ʻa Hepeloni, ko e kolo hūfanga, mo Lipina mo hono ngaahi potu ofi ʻo ia, mo Satili, mo Esitimoa, mo honau ngaahi potu ofi,
And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
Mo Heleni mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Tipa mo hono ngaahi potu ofi,
And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
Mo ʻAsani mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Pete-Semesi mo hono ngaahi potu ofi:
And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:

Pea mei he faʻahinga ʻo Penisimani; ko Kepa mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo ʻAlemeti mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo ʻAnatoti mo hono ngaahi potu ofi. Ko honau ngaahi kolo ki honau faʻahinga kotoa pē ko e kolo ʻe hongofulu ma tolu.
And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
Pea naʻe foaki ʻae kolo ʻe hongofulu ʻo tatau mo e tohi ʻoe talotalo, mei hono vaheua ʻoe faʻahinga ʻo Manase, ki he ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate, ʻakinautolu naʻe kei toe ʻi he fānau ʻoe faʻahinga ko ia.
And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

Pea naʻe foaki ʻae kolo ʻe hongofulu ma tolu ki he ngaahi foha ʻo Kesomi ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga kotoa pē, mei he faʻahinga ʻo ʻIsaka, pea mei he faʻahinga ʻo ʻAseli, pea mei he faʻahinga ʻo Nafitali, pea mei he faʻahinga ʻo Manase ʻi Pesani.

And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

Naʻe foaki ʻae kolo ʻe hongofulu ma ua ki he ngaahi foha ʻo Melali ʻi he talotalo, ki honau ngaahi faʻahinga, mei he faʻahinga ʻo Lupeni, pea mei he faʻahinga ʻo Kata, pea mei he faʻahinga ʻo Sepuloni.
Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
Pea naʻe foaki ʻe he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ki he kau Livai ʻae ngaahi kolo ni mo e ngaahi potu ofi ki ai.
And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

Pea naʻa nau foaki ʻi he talotalo, mei he faʻahinga ʻoe fānau ʻa Siuta, pea mei he faʻahinga ʻoe fānau ʻa Simione, pea mei he faʻahinga ʻoe fānau ʻa Penisimani, ʻae ngaahi kolo ko eni, ʻaia ʻoku ui ʻaki ʻa honau hingoa.

And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
Pea ko hono toe ʻoe ngaahi faʻahinga ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate naʻe ʻonautolu ʻae ngaahi kolo ʻo honau fonua mei he faʻahinga ʻo ʻIfalemi.
And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
Pea naʻa nau foaki kiate kinautolu, mei he ngaahi kolo hūfanga, ʻa Sikemi ʻi he moʻunga ko ʻIfalemi mo e ngaahi potu ofi ki ai; pea naʻa nau foaki foki ʻa Kesa mo hono ngaahi potu ofi,
And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
Mo Sokimiami mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Pete-Holoni mo hono ngaahi potu ofi,
And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,
Pea mo ʻAsaloni mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Kati-Limoni mo hono ngaahi potu ofi:
And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:
Pea mei hono vaheua ʻoe faʻahinga ʻo Manase; ko ʻAneli mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Piliami mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, ki he fānau naʻe toe ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate.
And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
Naʻe foaki ki he ngaahi foha ʻo Kesomi mei he fānau ʻoe vaheua ʻoe faʻahinga ʻo Manase, ʻa Kolani ʻi Pesani mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo ʻAsitelote mo hono ngaahi potu ofi:
Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
Pea mei he faʻahinga ʻo ʻIsaka; ko Ketesi mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Tapilati mo hono ngaahi potu ofi,
And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
Mo Lemoti mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo ʻAnemi mo hono ngaahi potu ofi:
And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
Pea mei he faʻahinga ʻo ʻAseli; ko Masali mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo ʻApitoni mo hono ngaahi potu ofi,
And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
Mo Hukoki mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Lehopi mo hono ngaahi potu ofi:
And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
Pea mei he faʻahinga ʻo Nafitali; ko Ketesi ʻi Kāleli mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Hamoni mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Kesatemi mo hono ngaahi potu ofi.
And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
Pea ki hono toe ʻoe fānau ʻa Melali naʻe foaki mei he faʻahinga ʻa Sepuloni, ʻa Limoni mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Tepoa mo hono ngaahi potu ofi:
Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:

Pea ʻi he kau vai ʻe taha ʻo Soatani ʻo ofi ki Seliko, ʻi he kau vai ʻa Soatani ki he feituʻu hahake, naʻe foaki mei he faʻahinga ʻa Lupeni, ʻa Peseli ʻi he toafa mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Sasa mo hono ngaahi potu ofi,
And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
Ko Ketimote foki mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Mefata mo hono ngaahi potu ofi:
Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
Pea mei he faʻahinga ʻa Kata; ko Lemoti ʻi Kiliati mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Mehanemi mo hono ngaahi potu ofi,
And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
Mo Hesiponi mo hono ngaahi potu ofi, mo Saseli mo hono ngaahi potu ofi.
And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
Pea ko eni ʻae ngaahi foha ʻa ʻIsaka: ko Tola, mo Pua, mo Sasupi, mo Similoni, ko e toko fā.
Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.

Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻa Tola; ko Usa, mo Lifaia, mo Silieli, mo Samei, mo Sipisami, mo Simueli, ko e kau mātuʻa ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau tamai, ʻio ʻo Tola: ko e kau tangata toʻa ʻakinautolu ʻi honau toʻutangata; pea ko honau tokolahi ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻa Tevita ko e toko ua mano mo e ua afe mo e onongeau.

And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father’s house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻa Usa; ko Isilaia: pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Isilaia; ko Mikaeli, mo ʻOpataia mo Soeli, mo Isia, ko e toko nima: ko e kau tangata ongoongoa kotoa pē ʻakinautolu.
And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

Pea naʻe kau mo kinautolu, ʻo fakatatau mo honau ngaahi toʻutangata, pea tatau mo e fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻae ngaahi vahenga kongakau ki he tau, ko e kautau ʻe toko tolu mano mo e toko ono afe: he naʻe tokolahi honau ngaahi uaifi pea mo ʻenau fānau tangata.
And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
Pea ko honau kāinga ʻi he ngaahi fānau ʻa ʻIsaka ko e kau tangata toʻa, pea ko honau lau fakataha ʻo fakatatau mo honau ngaahi toʻutangata ko e toko valu mano mo e toko fitu afe.
And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
Ko kinautolu eni naʻe ʻa Penisimani; ko Pela, mo Pekeli, mo Sitieli, ko e toko tolu.
The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Pela; ko Esiponi, mo Usa, mo ʻUsili, mo Selimoti, mo Ili, ko e toko nima: ko e kau mātuʻa ʻakinautolu ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau tamai, ko e kau tangata mālohi mo toʻa; pea naʻe lau ʻakinautolu ʻo fakatatau mo honau ngaahi toʻutangata, ko e toko ua mano mo e ua afe, mo e tolungofulu ma fā.

And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Pekeli; ko Simila, mo Soasi, mo ʻEliesa, Ilionei, mo Omili, mo Selimoti, mo ʻApia, mo ʻAnatoti, mo ʻAlemeti. Ko kinautolu ni kotoa pē ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Pekeli.
And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
Pea ko honau toko fiha, ʻo hangē ko honau hohoko mo honau ngaahi toʻutangata, ko e kau mātuʻa ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ko e kau tangata mālohi mo toʻa, ko e toko ua mano mo e uangeau.
And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
Ko e ngaahi foha foki ʻo Sitieli; ko Pilani: pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Pilani; ko Siusi, mo Penisimani, mo ʻEhuti, mo Kinana, mo Sitani, mo Tasisi, mo ʻApisahali.
The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

Ko e ngaahi foha eni kotoa pē ʻo Sitieli, ʻi he kau mātuʻa ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ko e kau tangata mālohi mo toʻa, pea naʻa nau tokotaha mano, mo e fitu afe ma uangeau ʻakinautolu naʻe faʻa ʻalu atu ke fai ʻae tau.
All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
Ko Supimi foki, mo Hupimi ko e fānau ʻa Ili, mo Husimi, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻAheli.
Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Nafitali; ko Sasieli, mo Kuni, mo Seseli, mo Salumi, ko e ngaahi tama ʻo Pila.
The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Manase: ko ʻAsilieli, ʻaia naʻe fāʻeleʻi ʻe hono uaifi: (ka naʻe fāʻeleʻi ʻe hono fefine sinifu mei ʻAmilami, ʻa Mekili ko e tamai kia Kiliati:
The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
Pea naʻe mali ʻa Mekili mo e tokoua ʻa Hupimi mo Supimi, pea ko hono hingoa ko Meaka;) pea ko e hingoa ʻa hono tokoua ko Silofitati: pea naʻe maʻu ʻe Silofitati ʻae ngaahi ʻofefine.
And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
Pea naʻe fāʻeleʻi ʻe Meaka ko e uaifi ʻa Mekili ha tama, pea naʻa ne fakahingoa ia ko Pelesi; pea ko e hingoa ʻa hono tokoua ko Selesi; pea ko hono ngaahi foha ʻoʻona ko Ulami, mo Lekemi.
And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Ulami; ko Pitani. Ko kinautolu ni ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Kiliati, ko e foha ʻo Mekili, ko e foha ʻo Manase.
And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
Pea naʻe fāʻeleʻi ʻe hono tuofefine ko Moleketi ʻa Isoti, mo ʻApiesa, mo Mala.
And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo Simita; ko ʻAhiani, mo Sikemi, mo Liki, mo ʻAniami.
And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻIfalemi: ko Sutela, mo Peleti ko hono foha, mo Tehati ko hono foha, mo Elata ko hono foha, mo Tehati ko hono foha,
And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
Mo Sapati ko hono foha, mo Sutela ko hono foha, mo Iseli, mo Elati, ʻaia naʻe tāmate ʻe he kau tangata mei Kati ʻaia naʻe fānau ʻi he fonua, ko e meʻa ʻi heʻenau ʻohifo ke ʻave ʻenau fanga manu.
And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
Pea naʻe tangi mamahi ʻenau tamai ko ʻIfalemi, ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho lahi, pea naʻe ʻalu ange ʻa hono kāinga ke fakafiemālie kiate ia.
And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
Pea ʻi heʻene hū atu ki hono uaifi naʻe tuʻituʻia ia, mo ne fāʻeleʻi ʻae tama, pea naʻa ne ui ʻa hono hingoa ko Pelia, koeʻuhi naʻe ʻaluʻalu ʻi mala ʻa hono fale.
And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
(Pea ko hono ʻofefine ko Sela ia, ʻaia naʻe langa hake ʻa Pete-holoni ki lalo, mo ia ki ʻolunga, pea mo Useni-Sela.)
(And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
Pea ko hono foha ʻa Lefa, mo Lesefi foki, mo Tela ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Tehani ko hono foha ʻoʻona,
And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
Mo Latana ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo ʻAmihuti ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Elisama ko hono foha ʻoʻona,
Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
Mo Nuni ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo Sosiua ko hono foha ʻoʻona.
Non his son, Jehoshuah his son,

Pea ko honau ngaahi tofiʻa mo honau ngaahi nofoʻanga eni, ko Peteli mo hono ngaahi kolo, pea ki he feituʻu hahake ʻa Neʻelani, pea ki he feituʻu lulunga ʻa Kesa mo hono ngaahi kolo ʻo ia; ko Sikemi foki mo hono ngaahi kolo ʻo aʻu atu ki Kesa mo hono ngaahi kolo ʻo ia:

And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:

Pea ofi ki he ngaahi ngataʻanga fonua ʻoe fānau ʻa Manase, ko Pete-Seani mo hono ngaahi kolo, mo Tenaki mo hono ngaahi kolo, mo Mekito mo hono ngaahi kolo, pea mo Toa mo hono ngaahi kolo. Naʻe nofo ʻi he ngaahi potu ko ia ʻae fānau ʻa Siosefa ko e foha ʻo ʻIsileli.
And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
Ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo ʻAseli: ko Simina, mo Isua, mo Isui, mo Pelia, mo Sela ko honau tuofefine.
The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Pelia: ko Hepa, mo Malikieli, ʻaia ko e tamai ʻa Pisaviti.
And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Hepa ʻa Safileti, mo Somela, mo Hotami, pea mo Sua ko honau tuofefine.
And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Safileti: ko Pasaki, mo Pimali, mo ʻAsivati. Ko e fānau ʻakinautolu ni ʻa Safileti.
And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sameli: ko ʻAhi, mo Loka, mo Sihupa, mo ʻAlami.
And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo hono tokoua ko Helemi: ko Sofa, mo Imina, mo Selesi, mo ʻAmali.
And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
Ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sofa: ko Sua mo Halinefa, mo Suali, mo Peli, mo Imila,
The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
Mo Peseli, mo Hoti, mo Sama, mo Silisa, mo Itilani, pea mo Peila.
Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Seteli; ko Sifune, mo Pisipa, pea mo ʻAla.
And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Ula: ko ʻAla, mo Hanieli, pea mo Lisia.
And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

Ko kinautolu ni kotoa pē ko e fānau ʻa ʻAseli, ko e kau mātuʻa ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau tamai, ko e kau tangata leleiʻia mo toʻa lahi ʻaupito, ko e tuʻukimuʻa ʻi he ngaahi ʻeiki. Pea ko honau tokolahi naʻe faʻa fai ʻae tau, ʻo fakatatau mo honau hohoko, ko e kau tangata ʻe toko ua mano mo toko ono afe.

All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father’s house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
Pea ko eni, naʻe tupu ʻia Penisimani ʻa hono ʻuluaki fānau ko Pela, mo hono toko ua ko ʻAsipeli, mo hono toko tolu ko ʻAhala,
Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
Mo Noha ko hono toko fā, mo Lafa ko hono toko nima.
Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Pela eni, ko ʻAtali, mo Kela, mo ʻApihuti,
And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
Mo ʻApisua, mo Neamani, mo ʻAhoa,
And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
Mo Kela, mo Sifufami, mo Hulami.
And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha eni ʻo ʻEhuti: ko e kau mātuʻa eni ʻi he ngaahi tamai ʻae kakai naʻe nofo ʻi Kepa, pea naʻa nau hiki ʻakinautolu ki Maneate:
And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
Pea ko Neamani, mo ʻAhia, mo Kela, naʻa ne fetuku ʻakinautolu, pea naʻe tupu ʻiate ia ʻa Usa, mo ʻAhiuti.
And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻae fānau meia Saheleimi ʻi he fonua ko Moape, ʻi he hili ʻa ʻene fekau ʻakinautolu ke ʻalu; pea ko Husimi mo Peala ko hono ongo uaifi ʻakinaua.
And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻi hono uaifi ko Hotesi, ʻa Sopapi, mo Sipia, mo Mesa, mo Malikami,
And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
Mo Siusi, mo Savia, mo Milima. Ko hono ngaahi foha ʻakinautolu ni, ko e kau tuʻukimuʻa ʻi he kau mātuʻa.
And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
Pea naʻe fanauʻi kiate ia ʻe Husimi, ʻa ʻApitupi, mo Elipeali.
And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Elipeali; ko Ipa, mo Misami, mo Sameli, ʻaia naʻe langa hake ʻa Ono, mo Loti, mo hona ngaahi kolo:
The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
Ko Pelia foki, mo Sema, ʻakinaua naʻe tuʻukimuʻa ʻi he kau mātuʻa ʻoe kakai ʻo ʻAsaloni, pea naʻa na kapusi atu ʻae kakai naʻe nofo ʻi Kati:
Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
Mo ʻAhio, mo Sasaki, mo Selimoti,
And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
Mo Sipatia, mo ʻAlatu, mo ʻAta,
And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
Mo Mikaeli, mo Isipa, mo Soha, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Pelia;
And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
Mo Sipatia, mo Mesulami, mo Hesiki, mo Hepa,
And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
Mo Isimelei foki, mo Sisilia, mo Sopapi, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Elipeali;
Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
Mo Sakimi, mo Sikili, mo Sapiti,
And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
Mo Elienei, mo Silitei, mo Ilieli,
And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
Mo ʻAtaia, mo Pelaia, mo Similati, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sema;
And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
Mo Isipani, mo Hepa, mo Ilieli,
And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
Mo ʻApitoni, mo Sikili, mo Henani,
And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
Mo Henania, mo ʻElami, mo ʻAnitotisa,
And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
Mo Ifitia, mo Penieli, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Sasaki;
And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
Mo Samisilei, mo Sialia, mo ʻAtalia,
And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
Mo Salesia, mo Elia, mo Sikili, ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Silohami.
And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
Ko e kau tuʻukimuʻa ʻakinautolu ni ʻi he kau mātuʻa, ʻo fakatatau mo honau ngaahi toʻutangata, ko e houʻeiki. Pea naʻe nofo ʻakinautolu ni ʻi Selūsalema.
These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
Pea naʻe nofo ʻi Kipione ʻae tamai ʻa Kipione; pea ko e hingoa ʻo hono uaifi ko Meaka:
And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife’s name was Maachah:
Pea ko hono ʻuluaki foha ko ʻApitoni, mo Suli, mo Kisi, mo Peali, mo Natapi,
And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
Mo Kitoa, mo ʻAhio, mo Sakeli.
And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Mikiloti ʻa Simia. Pea naʻe nofo foki ʻakinautolu ni mo honau kāinga ʻi Selūsalema, ʻo hangatonu atu kiate kinautolu.
And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
Pea naʻe tupu meia Nea ʻa Kisi, pea naʻe tupu meia Kisi ʻa Saula, pea tupu ʻia Saula ʻa Sonatane, mo Malikisua, mo ʻApinatapi, mo Esipeali.
And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
Pea ko e foha ʻo Sonatane: ko Milipi-Peali: pea naʻe tupu ʻia Milipi-Peali ʻa Maika.
And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Maika eni ko Pitoni, mo Meleki, mo Talia, mo ʻAhasi.
And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia ʻAhasi ʻa Sihoata pea naʻe tupu ʻia Sihoata ʻa ʻAlemeti, mo ʻAsimaveti, mo Simili; pea naʻe tupu ʻia Simili ʻa Mosa,
And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
Pea naʻe tupu ʻia Mosa ʻa Penia: pea ko hono foha ʻa Lefa, mo Eleasa ko hono foha ʻoʻona, mo ʻAseli ko hono foha ʻoʻona:
And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
Pea naʻe maʻu ʻe ʻAseli ʻae foha ʻe toko ono, pea ko honau hingoa eni; ko ʻAsilikami, mo Pokilu, mo ʻIsimeʻeli, mo Sialia, mo ʻOpataia, mo Hanani. Ko kinautolu ni kotoa pē ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻAseli.
And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo hono tokoua ko Eseki ʻa eni: ko hono ʻuluaki fānau ko Ulami, mo Sihusi ko hono toko ua, mo Ilifeleti ko hono toko tolu.
And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Ulami ko e kau tangata toʻa fakamanavahē ʻakinautolu, ko e kau toʻo fana, pea naʻa nau maʻu ʻae ngaahi foha tokolahi, mo e fānau tangata ʻo honau ngaahi foha, ko e toko teau ma nimangofulu. Ko kinautolu ni kotoa pē ko e fānau tangata ʻa Penisimani.
And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.

Naʻe pehē ʻae lau hake ʻa ʻIsileli kotoa pē ʻo hangē ko honau ngaahi toʻutangata; pea vakai, naʻe tohi ia ʻi he tohi ʻoe ngaahi tuʻi ʻo ʻIsileli mo Siuta, ʻakinautolu naʻe ʻave ki Papilone koeʻuhi ko ʻenau angahala.
So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
Pea ko eni, ko e kakai naʻe fuofua nofo ki honau fonua mo honau ngaahi kolo, ko e kakai ʻIsileli, ko e kau taulaʻeiki, mo e kau Livai, pea mo e kau Netinimi.
Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
Pea naʻe nofo ʻi Selūsalema mei he fānau ʻa Siuta, pea mei he fānau ʻa Penisimani, pea mei he fānau ʻa ʻIfalemi, pea mo Manase;
And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
Ko Utei ko e foha ʻo ʻAmihuti, ko e foha ʻo Omili, ko e foha ʻo Imili, ko e foha ʻo Pani, ʻi he fānau ʻa Felesi ko e foha ʻo Siuta.
Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
Pea mei he kakai Sailo: Ko e ʻuluaki fānau ko ʻAsaia, mo hono ngaahi foha ʻoʻona.
And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
Pea mei he ngaahi foha ʻo Sela; ko Siueli, mo honau ngaahi kāinga ʻe toko onongeau ma toko hivangofulu.
And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
Pea mei he ngaahi foha ʻo Penisimani; ko Salu ko e foha ʻo Mesulami, ko e foha ʻo Hotevia, ko e foha ʻo Hasinua,
And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
Mo Ipinaia ko e foha ʻo Silohami, mo Ela ko e foha ʻo Usi, ko e foha ʻo Mikili, mo Mesulami ko e foha ʻo Sifatia, ko e foha ʻo Liueli, ko e foha ʻo Ipinisa;
And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

Pea mo honau kāinga, ʻo fakatatau mo honau ngaahi toʻutangata, ko e toko hivangeau mo e toko nimangofulu ma ono. Ko kinautolu ni kotoa pē ko e kau tuʻukimuʻa ʻi he kau mātuʻa ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai.
And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
Pea ʻi he kau taulaʻeiki: ko Sitaia, mo Sikoialipe, mo Sakini,
And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
Mo ʻAsalia ko e foha ʻo Hilikia, ko e foha ʻo Mesulami, ko e foha ʻo Satoki, ko e foha ʻo Milaioti, ko e foha ʻo ʻAhitupi, ʻaia naʻe pule ʻi he fale ʻoe ʻOtua;
And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
Mo ʻAtaia ko e foha ʻo Silohami, ko e foha ʻo Pasuli, ko e foha ʻo Malikisa, mo Masei ko e foha ʻo ʻAtieli, ko e foha ʻo Sasela, ko e foha ʻo Mesulami, ko e foha ʻo Mesilimiti, ko e foha ʻo Imeli.
And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

Pea mo honau kāinga, ko e kau mātuʻa ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ko e toko taha afe mo e toko fitungeau ma onongofulu; ko e kau tangata toʻa lahi ʻaupito ʻi he fai ʻae ngāue ʻi he fale ʻoe ʻOtua.
And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
Pea ʻoe kau Livai: ko Simaia ko e foha ʻo Hasupi, ko e foha ʻo ʻAsilikami, ko e foha ʻo Hasapia, ʻi he ngaahi foha ʻo Melali;
And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
